# Bug Fix

Use the `[Bug]` action tag. Optionally add a `[Project-Tag]` for project-specific context.

## Examples

```
@workspace [Bug] Order confirmation email not sent when payment method is bank transfer
```

```
@workspace [Bug][CR2-Phase2] Drilling cost shows in estimation modal even when user hasn't selected hole_drilling_possible
```

```
@workspace [Bug] "Call to member function on null" error on product detail page when stock is zero
```
